paite: TOUPA phat un! Pathian a mun siangthou ah phat unla; athilhihtheihna huihkhua zapi ah amah phat un!
heading: TOUPA Phat Un!

paite: Athilhih thupitak ziak in amah phat unla; athupi mahmah dan bang in amah phat un!
Pengkul ging in amah phat unla; pekging leh kaihging in amah phat un!
Khuangta leh lam in amah phat unla; kaihging tuamtuam leh tamngai in amah phat un!
Dakkhutbet ngaihtak in amah phat unla; dakkhutbet ngaihtak in amah phat un!
Bangkim, hathei peuhmah in TOUPA phat hen! TOUPA phat un!
